SELECT O.ORDER_NO, OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTR( NVL2(PO.OPTION1_VALUE, ' / ' || PO.OPTION1_VALUE, NULL) || NVL2(PO.OPTION2_VALUE, ' / ' || PO.OPTION2_VALUE, NULL) || NVL2(PO.OPTION3_VALUE, ' / ' || PO.OPTION3_VALUE, NULL) , 4) AS OPTION_LABEL, OD.ORDER_QTY, OD.PRICE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.ORDER_DATE, M.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, M.PHONE AS BUYER_PHONE, IMG.IMAGE_URL AS THUMBNAIL_URL FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN ORDERS O ON OD.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON OD.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY OPTION_ID, IMAGE_ORDER) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IMAGE_PURPOSE = '대표' ) IMG ON IMG.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND IMG.RN = 1 WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo}
ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC, O.ORDER_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN ORDERS O ON OD.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = '결제완료' THEN O.ORDER_NO END) AS WAITING_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = '배송중' THEN O.ORDER_NO END) AS SHIPPING_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = '배송완료' THEN O.ORDER_NO END) AS DELIVERED_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = '배송완료' AND D.DELIVERY_END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(D.DELIVERY_END_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN O.ORDER_NO END) AS DELIVERED_TODAY_COUNT FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_DETAIL OD ON OD.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo}

SELECT D.DELIVERY_NO, D.ORDER_NO, D.DELIVERY_SERVICE_CODE, D.INVOICE_NO, D.DELIVERY_START_DATE, M.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, M.PHONE AS BUYER_PHONE, PN.PRODUCT_NAME, PN.ITEM_COUNT FROM DELIVERY D JOIN ORDERS O ON D.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN ( SELECT OD.ORDER_NO, MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO) AS PRODUCT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} GROUP BY OD.ORDER_NO ) PN ON PN.ORDER_NO = D.ORDER_NO WHERE D.DELIVERY_STATUS = '배송중' ORDER BY D.DELIVERY_START_DATE DESC

SELECT PR.RETURN_NO, PR.ORDER_DETAIL_NO, O.ORDER_NO, PR.RETURN_QTY, PR.REFUND_AMOUNT, PR.RETURN_REASON, PR.RETURN_STATUS, PR.REQUEST_DATE, CASE WHEN PR.RETURN_STATUS LIKE '취소%' THEN '취소' WHEN PR.RETURN_STATUS LIKE '반품%' THEN '반품' WHEN PR.RETURN_STATUS LIKE '교환%' THEN '교환' ELSE '기타' END AS RETURN_TYPE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTR( CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION1_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION1_VALUE END || CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION2_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION2_VALUE END || CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION3_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION3_VALUE END, 4) AS OPTION_LABEL, M.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, M.PHONE AS BUYER_PHONE, IMG.IMAGE_URL AS THUMBNAIL_URL FROM PRODUCT_RETURN PR JOIN ORDER_DETAIL OD ON PR.ORDER_DETAIL_NO = OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO JOIN ORDERS O ON OD.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON OD.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY OPTION_ID, IMAGE_ORDER) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IMAGE_PURPOSE = '대표' ) IMG ON IMG.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND IMG.RN = 1 WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} ORDER BY PR.REQUEST_DATE DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.ORDER_DATE, M.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, M.PHONE AS BUYER_PHONE, PN.PRODUCT_NAME, PN.ITEM_COUNT, PN.TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS O JOIN MEMBER M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN ( SELECT OD.ORDER_NO, MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO) AS PRODUCT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT, SUM(OD.PRICE * OD.ORDER_QTY) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} GROUP BY OD.ORDER_NO ) PN ON PN.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = '결제완료' ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = '배송중' WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND ORDER_STATUS = '결제완료' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE OD.ORDER_NO = ORDERS.ORDER_NO AND P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DELIVERY ( DELIVERY_NO, ORDER_NO, DELIVERY_SERVICE_CODE, INVOICE_NO, DELIVERY_STATUS, DELIVERY_START_DATE, DELIVERY_END_DATE, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_DELIVERY.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo}, #{deliveryServiceCode}, #{invoiceNo}, '배송중', SYSDATE, NULL, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.ORDER_DATE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.PRODUCT_AMOUNT, O.INSTANT_DISCOUNT, O.COUPON_DISCOUNT, O.CASH_USED, M.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, M.PHONE AS BUYER_PHONE, DA.RECEIVER_NAME, DA.TEL AS RECEIVER_TEL, DA.ZIPCODE, DA.ADDRESS, DA.DETAIL_ADDRESS, DA.REQUEST_MSG, DL.DELIVERY_SERVICE_CODE, DL.INVOICE_NO, DL.DELIVERY_STATUS, DL.DELIVERY_START_DATE, DL.DELIVERY_END_DATE FROM ORDERS O JOIN MEMBER M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN ORDER_ADDRESS DA ON O.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO = DA.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, DELIVERY_SERVICE_CODE, INVOICE_NO, DELIVERY_STATUS, DELIVERY_START_DATE, DELIVERY_END_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORDER_NO ORDER BY DELIVERY_NO DESC) AS RN FROM DELIVERY WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) DL ON DL.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND DL.RN = 1 WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE OD.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} )

SELECT OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTR( CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION1_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION1_VALUE END || CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION2_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION2_VALUE END || CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION3_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION3_VALUE END, 4) AS OPTION_LABEL, OD.ORDER_QTY, OD.PRICE FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON OD.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID WHERE OD.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} ORDER BY OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO
